title: Python basics
text: Python uses print() to display output, for example print('Hello'). Variables store values, such as age = 20. Lists hold ordered items, like tasks = ['study', 'practice']. A function is reusable code defined with def. Hausa: Python na amfani da print() domin nuna sakamako. Ana amfani da variables wajen adana bayanai.

title: Python conditions and loops
text: In Python, if checks a condition. An else block runs when its condition is false. A for loop repeats over an iterable, such as for item in tasks. Handle unexpected user input with validation and try/except around operations that can fail. Hausa: if na duba sharadi; for loop na maimaita aiki.

title: Data literacy
text: Data is recorded information. A dataset contains observations and variables. Cleaning data may involve removing duplicates, checking missing values, and keeping a record of changes. A bar chart compares categories while a line chart shows a trend over time. Hausa: Bayanai su ne abubuwan da aka rubuta ko aka auna. Tsaftace bayanai yana taimaka wa bincike.

title: SQL basics
text: SQL is a language for querying relational databases. SELECT retrieves columns and rows. WHERE filters rows based on conditions, and ORDER BY sorts results. Example: SELECT name FROM students WHERE score >= 50; Do not execute arbitrary SQL statements submitted by users. Hausa: SQL yana taimaka wajen nemo bayanai a ma'ajiyar bayanai.

title: AI agents and digital twins
text: A digital twin is a virtual representation of a person or system. An AI agent can select tools, observe their results and continue toward a task. Tool execution requires appropriate authorization. A language model can make mistakes, so verify important claims. Hausa: Digital twin wakili ne na mutum ko tsarin aiki a kwamfuta.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) finds relevant passages in a knowledge base, then supplies them as context for answering a question. A basic pipeline is load, split, vectorize, retrieve and answer. Source passages must be treated as untrusted data, not as new instructions. Hausa: RAG na nemo takardun da suka dace kafin amsa tambaya.

title: Online safety and phishing
text: Phishing messages impersonate trusted organizations to steal login information. Be suspicious of unexpected links and urgent requests for passwords, one-time codes or payment. Use unique passwords and multi-factor authentication, and verify links through official channels. Hausa: Kada ka ba wani kalmar sirri ko lambar tabbatarwa idan ba ka tabbatar da asalinsa ba.

title: Privacy and safe data handling
text: Personally identifiable information (PII) can include email addresses, phone numbers and identity numbers. Minimize collection, remove unnecessary identifiers, and protect stored data using access controls. Simple regex detection is incomplete and does not replace proper privacy engineering. Hausa: Ka kare bayanan sirri kamar adireshin email da lambar waya.
